A tour where you polish and finish a kuksa—a traditional Nordic wooden cup made from Hanno-grown timber—and enjoy a wood-fired pizza lunch.

【Fee】 ¥7,000 per person (includes guide, insurance, kuksa kit, and lunch)

【Capacity】 5 people

【Guide】 Staff from Certified NPO Naguri Canoe Workshop

【What to bring】 Apron, drinks

【More information】 Certified NPO Naguri Canoe Workshop: https://naguri-canoe.co.jp/
